scope: Existing synth interpretation, shared musical semantics, host voice ownership. No new persisted sound parameters or game scripting language.

plan.roundTrip: JSON-serialized plan feeds the current backend without DOM, device or storage objects

parameters.units: seconds, hz, cents, semitones, octaves, linear_gain, normalized, Q, pan, enum
parameters.controlChanges: Existing patches are snapshots at note-on. Interpolation metadata specifies target host policy; mid-note automation is not implemented until SYN-010.

oscillators.tuning: A4=440 Hz, equal temperament, frequency capped at 18000 Hz before detune
oscillators.waves: sine, triangle, square, sawtooth, 32-harmonic sine-coefficient recipe
oscillators.harmonicIndex: array[0] is fundamental; DC coefficient zero
oscillators.bandLimiting: Reference is the current Web Audio oscillator/normalized PeriodicWave. Future implementations must pass acoustic fixtures; bit equality across hosts is not required.
oscillators.gain: Levels sum with noise; normalize by max(1,total level); note peak=min(0.31,volume*velocity*0.27)*normalization, floored at 1e-6

noise.loop: ceil(sampleRate*2) samples, zero initial phase per voice
noise.decay: exponential target zero with time constant max(0.002,noiseDecay/5)

filter.reference: Web Audio biquad frequency and Q semantics
filter.sweep: initial cutoff=clamp(cutoff*2^sweep,50,14000), exponentially ramps to cutoff at start+min(gate,sweepTime)

expression.pitchCurve: 16..600 Float32 values at nominal 80 Hz control sampling; existing bend and glide semantics retained
expression.vibrato: sine, delayed depth ramp over 0.13 seconds, 0.02 second fade at gate end
expression.tremolo: unity plus sine modulation at depth=tremolo*0.45

effects.drive: Existing 1024-point quantized tanh curve, 4x oversampling, compensation 1/(1+drive*1.1)
effects.delay: linear per-voice dry path 1-delayMix*0.4; shared send delayMix*0.55; feedback; wet=0.8
effects.sharing: Only identical delayMix/time/feedback tuples share a bus in the same session. Patch edits create a different bus; old tails retain their original settings.
effects.tail: Conservative feedback recurrence bound at 1e-5 (-100 dBFS) for a full-scale input. Native release qualification still needs true-peak/headroom and device tests.

voicePolicy.execution: Control-thread planner, not a native real-time callback implementation
voicePolicy.intervals: Half-open [start,end); release and short graph-settling time consume a voice; shared delay tails do not
voicePolicy.stealOrder: lowest priority, released voices, oldest onset, stable admission order; vocal clips have priority 1, other voices 0
voicePolicy.futureNotes: Reservations include queued strums; overlapping future intervals are resolved deterministically even if requests arrive out of onset order
voicePolicy.physicalOverlap: Retiring sources can overlap replacements for the 5 ms fade; the logical voice budget excludes that bounded-duration transition
voicePolicy.stop: Stops owned oscillators, LFOs, noise, sample and vocal sources, cancels future starts, fades wet buses and disconnects after an audio-time deadline
voicePolicy.sustain: Current authored gate/release only; MIDI sustain pedal is unimplemented and remains in SYN-016

intendedBehaviorFixes: Stop actually terminates queued and sounding resources
identical delay lines share processing without changing musical routing
natural playback and WAV export retain long effect tails
saving a solo preset retains its instrument volume
compatibility.limits: No native device backend or pre-programmed parity is claimed. Extremely dense arrangements above the explicit host budget use voice stealing.

qualification.newcomer: tests/newcomer-check.html at desktop and phone widths
limitations: AudioWorklet capture observes render-graph gaps, not device-driver underruns
newcomer action checks do not replace observed comprehension studies
